flags: Item 397 (10 Dec 1992, SOURCE URL .../397) is titled 'MINUTES OF THE ASSOCIATED STUDENT GOVERNMENT' with an entirely different officer roster (President Heather Falmlen, Admin VP Seibert, PR VP Holcomb, Secretary Wilson/India Wilson, Treasurer Rains). This is a different student government body, not the WKU SGA Congress covered by the other 32 items — all names in it (Falmlen, Seibert, Holcomb, India Wilson, Kristen Graves, Tom Springer, Kathleen Young, Chelsea Klatt, Maya Petties, Hagan/Magan Rose, Mary Susan Bunce, Bobbi Petersen, Jerry Moore, Pam Wells as UCB chair there, etc.) were excluded from the members list.

Andrea Cailles was excluded per instructions as an already-recorded committee chair, but note she was later approved to a Representative at Large seat (9 Feb 1993, item 431) and appears on absence rolls in March and April 1993 — worth double-checking against however her committee-chair record is filed, since she plainly held a second, rank-and-file seat later in the year.

Pamela Wells (also 'Pam Wells') and Emily Brown appear once each on Congress absence rolls (20 Oct 1992 and 13 Apr 1993 respectively) while otherwise appearing only in the University Center Board organizational report as UCB's President/Executive Chairperson. Left out of the members list as ambiguous — it is unclear whether UCB's chair held an ex officio Congress seat or whether this is a coincidental/OCR mixup; worth a human check.

A five-person Judicial Council (Emily Morgan as chairman, Gretchen Ploch, Alan Thomason, Stacy Kitchens, Greg Butler) was approved 1 Dec 1992 (item 416). This is a separate body from Congress with no roll-call or seat evidence tying its members to a Congress seat, so none were added as rank-and-file members.

Scott Sivley, Joe Tinsley, Dawn Dillard, Cinnamon Roberts, and Crystal/Chrystal Smith were included as rank-and-file members on the strength of roll-call or motion evidence that predates or stands apart from their committee-chair service, but all five also served as committee chairs during the year (see the committees list) — flagging in case the project's committee-chair records already cover them and a duplicate entry would result.
No page in the surviving minutes states a total Congress seat count or membership size.

Spelling notes: 'Audrea Simpson' (unusual first name, spelled consistently), 'Nicole Creasy'/'Creasey', 'Thomas Lally'/'Tom Lally', 'Darron Brawner'/'Darren Brawner', 'Laura Jo Bland'/'LauraJo Bland', 'LauraLee Wilson'/'Laura Lee Wilson', 'Robert Wagner'/'Bobby Wagner', and 'Crystal Smith'/'Chrystal Smith' each vary between meetings and are treated here as the same person.

'Allen Martin' (27 Oct 1992 roll) is a best-effort read of an OCR line with no comma ('...Allen Martin Paul Smith...'); treated as two separate people since Paul Smith is independently well attested, but this specific name split is not certain.
